$comment: Legacy Altitude icon name -> Phosphor regular asset. HAND-AUTHORED, reviewed as data. Consumed by icons/icons-config.mjs, which emits components/icon/icon-aliases.ts. Never edit the generated file.

kinds.identity: Legacy name IS the Phosphor name. Listed for completeness so this file is an exhaustive census of the 37.
kinds.exact: Different name, same glyph concept. No visual judgment required.
kinds.near: A human made a judgment call. `note` records the reasoning so the next reviewer does not relitigate it.

chevron-down.note: Phosphor regular carets are open chevron strokes, not filled triangles.

document.note: Legacy draws a page outline plus three interior rules. Plain `file` has no interior lines.

filter.note: Legacy is a closed funnel outline with a handle. `funnel-simple` is three decreasing horizontal lines - a different glyph.

help.note: Phosphor `question` has concentric circles (r=104/88) enclosing the mark, matching legacy's enclosing circle. It is not a bare mark.

home.note: Legacy has a door cutout. `house-simple` omits it.

layout-masonry.note: No Phosphor icon is a true masonry. Legacy is 4 staggered unequal panes in 2 columns (left tall+short, right short+tall, no outer frame). `squares-four` preserves pane count, column count and the absence of a frame but equalizes heights. `layout` is only 3 panes inside a frame - worse. FLAGGED for a designer's eye.

list.note: Legacy `list` is three hollow squares in the left gutter plus three lines - a bulleted list. `list-dashes` has the same skeleton (square-capped dashes at x40-56, lines at x88-216). `list-bullets` uses circles; `list-checks` adds done/completed semantics. NOTE: the name `list` is shadowed - <al-icon name="list"> resolves to the Phosphor hamburger, NOT this glyph. See the precedence rule in AGENTS.md.

menu.note: Legacy `menu` is three full-width bars at y 5.625/10/14.375 of 20. Phosphor `list` is three full-width bars at y 64/128/184 of 256. Identical glyph.

pin.note: NOT `push-pin` - that is a thumbtack, a different object. Legacy is a ring head (cy 8.2, outer r 5.2 / inner r 3.8) + a straight vertical stem + a wide flat ground ellipse at y=18 spanning x 3-21. `map-pin-simple-line` is exactly that construction (ring head cy=80 r=40, straight stem to y=208, ground line x 40-216). `map-pin-line` is a teardrop marker - wrong head shape.

send.note: Legacy points up-and-right at ~45 degrees with a visible center fold. `paper-plane-right` is axis-aligned.

settings.note: Legacy draws 8 nubs (4 axial + 4 diagonal). `gear-six` has 6.

support.note: NOT `lifebuoy`. Legacy draws a headband arc across the top (x 3.8-20.2), two rounded ear-cup rects (x 5.2-8.2 and x 15.8-18.8), and a hook descending right to a chin strap. That is unambiguously a headset.

warning-triangle.note: Phosphor `warning` is the triangle-with-bang. Keeps the pair coherent with `warning-circle`, which is an identity match.
